scope: Read-only merge-preparation snapshot; no merge or working-tree changes
method: Enumerated main status with individual untracked files, intersected with paths changed from local main HEAD to candidate, and compared clean-filtered git blob hashes of existing overlapping files to the candidate tree. Checked size and modification time around hashing. Remote head was read without fetching or changing refs.
limitations: This is a time-specific snapshot, not an exhaustive merge-conflict classification or permission to overwrite local work.
The candidate gained this evidence commit after measurement; re-evaluate the current state immediately before any integration.
Native, independent restore ownership and reliable large-project resource gates remain open.
